notes.title: [NEWS] Vibrant Frame – It’s Finally Here!
notes.content:
Hey,

We’ve got some exciting news – Vibrant Frame is officially out! 

We know many of you have been waiting for this moment, and it’s finally here. As a thank-you for your patience and support, we’re kicking things off with a 15% launch discount for 14 days only!

Your love and encouragement mean everything to us. With your support, we’ll keep creating more beautiful Otome games for you to enjoy.

Don’t miss your chance to step into the world of Vibrant Frame. We can’t wait to hear what you think.

notes.title: [NEWS] Vibrant Frame is Finally Launching!
notes.content:
Hey,

I’ve got something to share: [u][b]“Vibrant Frame” will be available on December 16th PST.[/b][/u]
I know some of you have been waiting a while for this, so thank you for hanging in there.

If you’re planning to write reviews or put together some review videos, I’ve got you covered. Check out the link below.

Link: https://linktr.ee/smilegate.support


Alright, that’s it for now.

Take care,
Hanjoo

notes.title: [EVENT] Stretch Goal is Now Open
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045758/73dfe3d3503b8ea182416bcf5fc5ba6173ed616b.png[/img]

Hey,

We’re excited to announce that our Stretch Goal is now open to celebrate our participation in Next Fest!

Here’s the deal: the more wishlists we get, the more awesome content we’ll unlock for you. Simple as that.

Stretch Goal Roadmap:

[olist]
[*] 5,000 Wishlists: Original Wallpaper Pack DLC
[*] 10,000 Wishlists: Special Wallpaper DLC 1
[*] 15,000 Wishlists: Special Wallpaper DLC 2
[*] 20,000 Wishlists: Community Item with Trading Cards
[/olist]

Your support means the world to us. Keep adding to that wishlist, and let’s make this happen.

That’s all for now.

Take care,
Hanjoo

notes.title: [NEWS] Vibrant Frame Demo is Out
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45045758/83050e0483dccc1ab1a7ecdc278b6327e459144f.png[/img]

Hey,

So, we've got some news. The demo for "Vibrant Frame" is now available. Yeah, you heard me right. You can finally get your hands on it.

I hope you enjoy the demo. If you like it, don't forget to add it to your wishlist. You want to be notified when the game officially releases, right?

Well, that's all from me.

Take care,
Hanjoo
